drafts.title: PQC Hybrid Commitment (PQCHC) X.509 v3 Extension
drafts.ipr_note: Author has filed or intends to file US patent applications covering subject matter herein. Patent licensing terms not yet known. See IETF Datatracker IPR disclosure page.
whitespace_created: X.509 v3 extension encoding a PQ hybrid commitment (PQCHC) from a certificate subject, asserting post-quantum or composite algorithm continuity across the current certificate lifetime
Subject-side pqhcCommitment ASN.1 structure carrying algorithm OID, commitment validity window, and optional continuity policy URI
Non-critical extension deployment path preserving RFC 5280 backward compatibility
Conceptual gap addressed: subject-side declaration of PQ intent, complementary to CA-side issuance continuity (addressed by rotation-envelope)
patent_enablement: Method for embedding a post-quantum algorithm commitment in an X.509 v3 extension field covered by a CA's digital signature at issuance time
System and method for machine-verifiable subject-side PQ continuity signaling in a multi-year PKI migration window
Non-critical extension structure allowing legacy relying parties to ignore the field while enabling PQ-aware relying parties to cache and enforce continuity expectations

drafts.title: CA-Side Post-Quantum Rotation Envelope for X.509 Issuance Continuity
drafts.ipr_note: Author has filed or intends to file US patent applications covering subject matter herein. Patent licensing terms not yet known. See IETF Datatracker IPR disclosure page.
whitespace_created: CA-side X.509 v3 extension encoding a Rotation Envelope: a cryptographically bound, CA-signed commitment to issuing-CA continuity across the CA's own key-rotation boundaries during PQ migration

PQRotationEnvelope ASN.1 structure carrying: envelopeValid (BOOLEAN), envelopeCommittedAlgorithmSet (AlgorithmIdentifier), futureKeyCommitment (EnvelopeManifestReference, OPTIONAL), envelopeNotAfter (GeneralizedTime), manifestURI (IA5String, OPTIONAL)
EnvelopeManifestReference sub-structure: hashAlgorithm, spkiHash (OCTET STRING over DER-encoded future SPKI), keyAlgorithmHint (OPTIONAL)
Machine-verifiable downgrade detection: relying parties cache spkiHash at issuance and verify it against successor certificate SPKI at renewal
ACME-ARI integration hook: envelopeNotAfter provides scheduling anchor for RFC 9773 suggestedWindow; CA validates spkiHash match at ACME order time
Commitment revocation path without certificate revocation: envelopeValid=FALSE signals rescission
Experimental OID arc 1.3.6.1.4.1.65953.1.1 for pre-IANA deployment
Conceptual gap addressed: CA-side issuance capability continuity, orthogonal to subject-side intent declaration (PQCHC / draft-reddy)
patent_enablement: Method for binding a cryptographic hash of a future SubjectPublicKeyInfo to a current X.509 certificate via a CA-signed non-critical extension, enabling key-specific forward commitment
System and method for detecting certificate-level downgrade attacks during a PKI post-quantum migration window using a cached spkiHash pre-commitment
Method for revoking a forward key commitment without revoking the bearer certificate by issuing a successor certificate with envelopeValid set to FALSE

Integration method for ACME Renewal Information (RFC 9773) with a CA-side PQ rotation envelope, using envelopeNotAfter as the suggestedWindow upper bound and validating CSR SPKI against the committed hash at order time
Non-critical X.509 v3 extension structure enabling PQ-migration-aware relying parties to enforce commitment semantics while legacy relying parties remain unaffected

whitespace_summary.description: Together these two drafts fill a two-sided gap in IETF LAMPS PQ migration infrastructure. No existing RFC or adopted WG draft provides either mechanism.
whitespace_summary.subject_side_gap: draft-vicente-lamps-pqchc-03 fills the subject-side gap: no mechanism existed for a certificate subject to declare, within the certificate, which PQ or composite algorithm it will use in the successor certificate.
whitespace_summary.ca_side_gap: draft-vicente-lamps-rotation-envelope-02 fills the CA-side gap: no mechanism existed for an issuing CA to cryptographically bind its own issuance capability commitment across its key-rotation boundaries.
whitespace_summary.combined_gap_closed: Together they provide end-to-end PQ migration assurance: subject declares intent (PQCHC), CA guarantees capability (Rotation Envelope), relying party can machine-verify both directions.

patent_enablement_summary.basis: 35 U.S.C. § 112 written description and enablement.
